name: DFARS 252.246-7008 Sources of Electronic Parts (JAN 2023)
short_name: DFARS sources of electronic parts clause
authority: US Department of Defense (Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement)
requirements: Contractors must first buy in-production parts from the original manufacturer, its authorized suppliers, or suppliers that buy exclusively from them; otherwise from contractor-approved suppliers vetted with industry counterfeit-prevention standards (contractor assumes authenticity risk, subject to government audit); any other source requires written notice to the contracting officer plus inspection, testing and authentication. Non-authorized contractors need risk-based traceability from the original manufacturer. Flows down to subcontracts incl. commercial products. Implements NDAA FY2012 s.818(c)(3) as amended. name: DFARS 252.246-7007 Contractor Counterfeit Electronic Part Detection and Avoidance System (JAN 2023)
short_name: DFARS counterfeit detection and avoidance system clause
authority: US Department of Defense (Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement)
jurisdiction: United States (DoD contracts subject to Cost Accounting Standards; flowed down to subcontractors)
requirements: CAS-covered contractors must maintain a risk-based counterfeit detection and avoidance system (training, inspection/testing, traceability, use of trusted suppliers, reporting and quarantine of counterfeit and suspect counterfeit parts to the contracting officer and GIDEP, no return to seller until authenticated, flow-down to all supply-chain tiers, screening of GIDEP reports, control of obsolete parts). Inadequate system can lead to purchasing-system disapproval or payment withholding. [@c_dfars7007_gidep, @c_dfars7007_scope]
